head: 5c68e54b17a87d916782191b1e388a7510d020ea
method: Read-only design-to-test assertion mapping. No test, build, packaging or product command executed by this mapping agent; no repository files changed.
adoptionRule: PASS recommendations are conditional on root recording a successful current-tree regression. Synthetic evidence cannot be promoted to real-model, real host-only execution, enterprise, fresh-machine or native-Windows acceptance.

cases.title: 多工具结果关联
cases.expected: 逐一对应，写工具串行且结果不串线
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: assistant really calls shared authoring and persists receipts; duplicate call IDs do not repeat writes
tests.actualAssertions: 同一 callId 在后续单独模型轮次再次提出时，仅有一个完成工具回执，workflow revision 仍为1。

tests.testName: common, coordinated, postfix and interrogative negatives deny actual run/publish proposals; affirmative combined actions remain executable
tests.actualAssertions: 正向创建、发布、运行按三次独立模型轮次提出；每轮只返回一个call。

missingAssertions: 没有同一模型响应包含多个不同callId的场景。
未断言多个写工具执行不重叠、按依赖串行，且每个回送tool_call_id/call_id与对应结果一致。

cases.title: usage缺失
cases.expected: 显示未知，不能当作免费或0花费
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: Responses and Chat Completions use separate envelopes and protocol paths
tests.actualAssertions: 两个HTTP协议适配器在响应不含usage时都返回usage=null。

missingAssertions: 未断言助手任务持久化结果中usage保持未知，以及未被累计为0。
没有浏览器断言usage缺失时显示“未知”，且未显示免费/0花费。

cases.title: 错参修复
cases.expected: 按错误纠正，原checkpoint不被误消费
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: tool validation feedback permits bounded correction and preserves Web revision conflicts
tests.actualAssertions: 先返回REVISION_CONFLICT，后修订revision成功；Web description保留。

tests.testName: analysis correction budgets 1/2/3 count the initial attempt, account usage and retain checkpoint on exhaustion
tests.actualAssertions: analysis invalid-json按预算尝试；耗尽时保留checkpoint id；第二次有效JSON可完成。

tests.testName: host output contracts cannot be weakened and published checkpoints use immutable capability schemas / invalid submissions leave the same checkpoint available
tests.actualAssertions: 内部engine收到错类型/缺字段/额外字段输出后返回INPUT_INVALID，checkpoint和revision不变，随后有效输出可完成。

missingAssertions: 没有助手同一任务先收到TYPE_MISMATCH反馈、再按该错误修正的完整场景。
checkpoint保留的直接engine断言和助手纠错断言分属不同场景，不能组合推断原checkpoint只被正确结果消费一次。

cases.title: 用户取消
cases.setup: 正在生成与等待工具结果分别取消
cases.expected: 停止后续动作，不盲重放已派发调用
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: cancellation aborts pending generation with no tool writes
tests.actualAssertions: 模型生成等待时cancel，任务CANCELLED，workflow零写入。

tests.testName: failed and cancelled analysis acceptance replays original task, while a fresh key can retry
tests.actualAssertions: cancelled analysis用原幂等key返回原task；新key允许重试。

tests.testName: session deletion waits for cancelling workers so delayed receipts cannot recreate deleted copies
tests.actualAssertions: 取消worker尚未收敛时不能删除session；收敛后删除不再留下task/event。

missingAssertions: 未测试真实工具已经派发、正在等待异步结果时取消。
未断言已派发调用只执行一次、已完成回执保留、后续模型轮次和工具均停止。

cases.title: SSE断连
cases.setup: 工具成功后前端断网再连
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: formal assistant UI rejects negative execution, displays context/config, and deletes session
tests.actualAssertions: 截断的是消息提交POST的acceptance响应；重发后模型请求仍1次，但此任务因INTENT_NOT_ALLOWED失败，未发生成功patch。

tests.testName: assistant really calls shared authoring and persists receipts; duplicate call IDs do not repeat writes
tests.actualAssertions: 账本阻止后续模型轮次的同callId重复创建。

missingAssertions: 没有成功patch之后浏览器SSE断网再连的场景。
未断言按eventId补读并恢复画布/工具回执，同时patch命令/revision/写入次数不增加。

cases.title: 发布意图
cases.setup: 明确创建并发布与只保存对照
cases.expected: 分别执行预期动作，不加人工审批
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: assistant really calls shared authoring and persists receipts; duplicate call IDs do not repeat writes
tests.actualAssertions: 请求文本为“保存草稿，不要发布或执行”；实际草稿持久化且COMPLETED，versions=0、runs=0。

tests.testName: common, coordinated, postfix and interrogative negatives deny actual run/publish proposals; affirmative combined actions remain executable
tests.actualAssertions: 多个否定/询问意图拒绝发布或运行；明确“创建、发布并运行”在同任务真实完成，新增version和run。

cases.note: 仅建议合成HTTP/Scripted层通过。正向请求包含运行，是明确创建并发布的已授权连续动作；未作真实模型意图效果验收推断。

cases.title: 文档升级
cases.setup: 修改帮助文档并重建索引
cases.expected: hash与行号更新；旧引用可识别过期
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: knowledge citations hash actual source ranges, expose stale sources, and history has a real cursor
tests.actualAssertions: 每个当前chunk内容/hash与实际source行范围相符；人为改坏索引contentHash后source.stale=true，rebuild后false。

missingAssertions: 未实际修改帮助文档正文/插入行后重建索引。
未断言新contentHash及行号随源变更更新，也未断言先前发给用户的旧citation可识别过期。
cases.note: 测试修改的是knowledge_chunks.contentHash，不能等价于文档真实升级场景。

cases.title: 大业务输出
cases.expected: 分页/截断明确标注，原产物保持完整
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: report requires actual chapters/bytes, references and bounded UTF-8 reads
tests.actualAssertions: 报告保存实际内容与证据；artifact_read的小maxBytes读取遵守UTF-8边界。

missingAssertions: 没有选择超过助手上下文预算的大artifact并发送模型的场景。
未断言模型请求/任务摘要含明确截断范围、总长度和续读方式。
未比较上下文截断前后原artifact全部字节/hash保持完整。

cases.title: 不默认外发历史
cases.expected: 没有自动附加全部运行数据或Key
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: real message provenance scopes history by selected run/artifacts and provider; clearing selection never reuses old run answers
tests.actualAssertions: 真实HTTP请求体在清除run/换Provider/选其他run时排除旧run私有结果及无来源旧消息；对应来源history仅同Provider同上下文时复用。

tests.testName: assistant UI labels past run provenance while clearing run and changing provider excludes that history
tests.actualAssertions: 浏览器先选run后清除，最后模型请求不含原run结果；页面仍展示有来源的历史消息。

tests.testName: model profile Key is encrypted and never stored in command or ordinary profile bodies
tests.actualAssertions: Profile/普通表/命令账本无Key明文。

missingAssertions: 缺少普通帮助请求在预存多条无关运行/产物时，明确断言所有未选中业务内容均不进入Provider消息。
没有对Provider请求消息显式断言配置中的模型Key/连接secret均未附加；存储密文检查不等价于上下文外发检查。
cases.note: 历史隔离回归实质增强，但按完整expected仍保留PARTIAL。

cases.title: 运行所有权
cases.expected: 沿用owner检查，不经检索旁路读取
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: selected workflow and run constrain reads, tests, start and cancellation before dispatch
tests.actualAssertions: 同execution owner下，工具越过选定workflow/run会INTENT_NOT_ALLOWED，工具账本为空。

tests.testName: per-host token is workflow-scoped, cannot read another owner, and revocation takes effect
tests.actualAssertions: 原MCP身份权限/运行owner隔离有效，另一个执行身份读取run拒绝。

missingAssertions: 未以owner A的assistant session选中/读取owner B的run和artifact，并检查Provider零收到相关内容。
未通过project_help_search/知识上下文路径尝试读取其他owner资料以证明检索不成为旁路。
cases.note: 选中对象限制不是跨owner测试；MCP原owner负测不自动证明assistant知识路径。

cases.title: 发现页面多态
cases.expected: 文案准确，未知不显示0项已安装
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: discovery accepts an explicit executable and remembers configuration-only selection without launching Codex
tests.actualAssertions: 真实发现页能选择显式CLI及config_only；页面分别观察到SUCCEEDED/PARTIAL，选择刷新后保留。

missingAssertions: 未分别控制并断言loading、failed、empty状态。
未断言partial/failed未知计数显示未知而非“0项已安装”。

cases.title: 工具加入画布
cases.expected: 生成真实节点，刷新后存在
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: real UI model settings, assistant create/patch, canvas persistence, undo, dirty conflict and Mock selftest
tests.actualAssertions: AI创建blank草稿并新增condition节点；浏览器画布节点增至3，reload后仍有3。

tests.testName: official MCP 21-tool discovery/import/author/generate/mock/publish/start/advance/report loop persists real state
tests.actualAssertions: SDK链路发现/导入实际能力和binding并编排mcp_tool；非浏览器CapabilityPicker链路。

missingAssertions: 未在真实能力目录/CapabilityPicker选择实际capability和binding并点击加入画布。
未断言该mcp_tool的真实capabilityRef/bindingId持久化、刷新后仍正确。

cases.title: 自测过期
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: real UI model settings, assistant create/patch, canvas persistence, undo, dirty conflict and Mock selftest
tests.actualAssertions: 浏览器运行Mock，断言“实际自测状态：SUCCEEDED”；后续直接离开页面。

tests.testName: accepted test baselines stay stale after same-fixture suite regeneration and capability drift
tests.actualAssertions: 后端成功自测后改input schema，status.stale=true；布局修改不失效；suite重建和capability漂移也保留stale。

tests.testName: deterministic generation executes numeric/string boundaries and both boolean branches
tests.actualAssertions: 成功自测后语义修改导致stale=true，再运行旧suite报TEST_BASELINE_STALE。

missingAssertions: 没有浏览器在成功自测后修改草稿，并断言旧结果显示stale/过期且不再持续绿色全通过。
cases.note: 后端stale已得到直接行为断言；该ID属于L3界面验收，不能由后端PASS代替。

cases.title: host-only节点
cases.expected: 网页准确说明需要宿主；Codex实际交接
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: host-only checkpoint freezes identity and arguments and cannot be consumed by a model Key
tests.actualAssertions: host_tool检查点固定能力/参数；Key分析入口HOST_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE且模型请求=0；内部engine.advance记录host_reported。

tests.testName: script stage: codex_mcp_author_test_publish_execute_report
tests.actualAssertions: 本机Codex脚本实际经App Server调用FlowHub；所编排的是report_template流程，无host_tool/host_skill检查点。

missingAssertions: 未以浏览器断言网页模型Key路径准确展示“需要Codex宿主”提示。
未由实际Codex会话接收host-only checkpoint、执行对应宿主能力并回传结果；内部engine.advance只能证明合成宿主回执。
cases.note: 保持真实宿主验收边界；原本本机Codex脚本不能提升此项为真实宿主节点PASS。

cases.title: 发布修订变化
cases.expected: CAS拒绝过期发布，旧版本不变
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: v2 HTTP/service publication requires the shared DTO and reviewed binding CAS
tests.actualAssertions: v2发布携带binding revision=1，实际binding升至2后HTTP409；更新reviewed revision才可发布；随后binding升至3，旧发布快照不变；幂等回执保持。

tests.testName: publication binds the reviewed binding revisions and preserves previous immutable versions
tests.actualAssertions: 原v1发布路径在binding变更后拒绝过期review map，草稿revision与既有版本不变。

missingAssertions: v2没有先validate得到capabilitySnapshot、再修改被引用capability并使用旧expectedCapabilityRevisions发布的明确负测。
缺少能力漂移拒绝时既有v2发布版本及hash/新version缺失的断言。
cases.note: binding CAS分支有直接测试；完整binding/capability条件仍建议PARTIAL。

cases.title: Schema漂移
cases.expected: 修订递增，相关草稿定位问题
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: schema-only and description-only catalog drift create immutable connections with matching contracts
tests.actualAssertions: 同一目录改变输入Schema/输出Schema/description；重新导入得到新connection，binding指向当前cap修订，旧connection/binding保持。

tests.testName: PLUG-08: Skill content drift advances semantic revision, mtime-only refresh does not, and publication stays immutable
tests.actualAssertions: Skill真实内容漂移使revision=2，相关草稿有CAPABILITY_STALE，旧revision/发布快照不变。

missingAssertions: 没有对同一工具已有入参由string改number等明确类型变更的场景；当前schema-only测试加入新的requiredField。
schema-only工具漂移测试未建立引用该能力的草稿并断言定位问题/nodeId/path及修订递增；Skill漂移不能替代工具入参类型漂移。

cases.title: 升级文档可操作
cases.expected: 步骤和真实CLI一致，缺项明确
cases.recommendationScope: source assertion coverage only; adopt PASS only after root current-tree regression succeeds

tests.testName: script stages: actual_v1_program_create_publish_run_report_backup; upgrade_to_v2_preserves_every_v1_row_and_report; stopped_restore_and_actual_old_program_restart
tests.actualAssertions: 隔离目录提取实际旧源码并启动旧CLI，创建报告和备份，内部startDaemon升级，内部restoreBackup恢复，旧CLI重启，所有旧行/hash/报告相同。

missingAssertions: 未在干净新机/独立测试账号逐步按docs/V2_MIGRATION.md和本地教程操作离线候选。
脚本中升级/恢复采用内部startDaemon/restoreBackup，未直接验教程对应候选目录launcher及restore CLI步骤。
无原生Windows教程操作证据，不能提升Windows验收。
cases.note: 原acceptance-results.json该项为UNVERIFIED而非PARTIAL。suggestedStatus=PARTIAL仅表达已有部分迁移演练证据；若保留原矩阵语义，报告状态仍建议UNVERIFIED，不应自动覆盖成PASS。
